data.name: Asimah
data.gender_notes: Asimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Asimah is an Arabic name that means companion or friend. In Islamic tradition, it is also used to refer to the female companions of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name Asimah carries the meaning “Companion, Friend” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Asimah usually hope their child will grow to embody companion, friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who is a close friend and companion of the righteous.
data.etymology: Asimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companion, Friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asimah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: عاصمة
in_arabic.meaning: اسمها من العاصمة، وهي الحامية والحافظة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عاصمة مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع ص م' الذي يحمل معنى الحماية والحفظ. في اللغة العربية، العاصمة تعني الحامية أو الحافظة. هذا الاسم يوحي بالحماية والرعاية، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحماية الإلهية. اسم عاصمة هو اسم مؤنث، ويتميز بمعناه العميق الذي يعبر عن الحماية والرعاية.

in_urdu.name: عاصمہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عاصمہ کا نام عربی جڑ 'ع ص م' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے حفاظت کرنا یا حامی ہونا۔ اردو میں، عاصمہ کا ترجمہ حامی یا محافظ کے طور پر کیا جاتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر قرآن مجید میں جہاں حفاظت اور حمیات کا ذکر ہے۔ عاصمہ ایک نسائی نام ہے جو اپنی گہری معانی کے لئے جانا جاتا ہے جو حفاظت اور دیکھ بھال پر زور دیتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: आसीमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: आसीमा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'ع ص م' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है रक्षा करना या संरक्षण करना। हिंदी में, आसीमा का अर्थ है रक्षक या संरक्षक। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है, खासकर कुरआन में जहां रक्षा और संरक्षण का उल्लेख है। आसीमा एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अपनी गहरी अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए जाना जाता है जो रक्षा और देखभाल पर जोर देता है।

in_pashto.name: عاصمه
in_pashto.long_meaning: عاصمه نوم د عربی جڑ 'ع ص م' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د حفاظت یا حامی کیدل دي. په پښتو کې، عاصمه د حامی یا ساتورن په توګه ژباړل کیږي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو سره تړاو لري، او د اسلامي روایت کې د پام وړ دی، په ځانګړي ډول قرآن کریم کې چیرې چې د حفاظت او حمياتو يادونه دي.

in_english.name: Asimah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Asimah originates from the Arabic root 'ع ص م' (ʿ-ṣ-m), which conveys the meaning of protection or guardianship. In Islamic tradition, Asimah is associated with concepts of safety and preservation. The Quran references protection and guardianship in several verses, highlighting the spiritual significance of this name. Asimah symbolizes strength, care, and responsibility, making it a meaningful choice for a child.

data.cultural_impact: The name Asimah holds significant cultural importance in Islamic societies. Naming a child Asimah signifies the hope that the child will grow up to be a loyal friend and companion to others. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) had many female companions who were devoted to him and his teachings, and the name Asimah serves as a reminder of their virtuous qualities such as faith, dedication, and loyalty. These qualities continue to be valued and celebrated in Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Asimah is rooted in the Islamic belief in the extent of the companionship between believers and Allah. As believers, we strive to be in a constant state of remembrance and connection with Allah, and the name Asimah serves as a reminder of the closeness and companionship we can achieve with Him. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was a close companion and friend to Allah, and his life and teachings serve as an exemplary model for how we can seek to build a similar companionship with our Creator. By embracing the name Asimah, individuals can be inspired to deepen their spiritual relationship with Allah, and embodied the qualities of loyalty and devotion that are celebrated in Islamic tradition.
